description: KERNEL record-type registry for the record store (OOS-0003, ADR-0009). Binds record type names to schemas and a mutability rule. Domain-neutral: it names schema types, never domain meaning. Immutable types are append-only (change by superseding); mutable types keep every prior revision in history. context-package is not registered yet: its schema identifies packages by package_id, not id (decide in OOS-0006).
